name: observIQ Blitz Telemetry Generator
free_limit: Apache-2.0-licensed local telemetry generation CLI and Docker tool for synthetic logs and load testing OpenTelemetry collectors; configurable generators, rates and output targets, with no vendor-enforced software quota or expiry.
